title: legacy, memory, through, strict
summary: A byte-bounded exact LRU inside the application process. Included in the budget rather than treated as free. Write-through: the new value is never published before the database commit; the writer tombstones, commits, then republishes only the committed representation. A read that begins after a write to that key was acknowledged must not return an older value; a violation fails the cell. The legacy model supplies no token, so strict freshness rests on invalidation alone or on an authoritative read.
risk: MUST record zero stale-after-ack reads and zero impossible cache values; a single wrong read invalidates the cell for performance conclusions

faults.correctness: tombstone removed the pre-existing entry; the rolled-back mutation left no cache value (fill -> fill); the next read returned fresh
